headline: ASX Healthcare Index Falls as Mayne Pharma Agrees to $604 Million Buyout
summary: The ASX healthcare index declined over the week, even as Mayne Pharma agreed to a $604 million acquisition deal amid broader equity market weakness.
why: M&A valuations in pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors indicate private equity and corporate transaction multiples despite sector-level public equity weakness.

impacts.name: Mayne Pharma Group
impacts.why: Agreed acquisition at $604 million valuation drives target share price toward offer price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Buyout offer premium lifted Mayne Pharma, while general market sell-off weighed on the broader healthcare index.
